description: Java interface 'ConnectionConfig' defining configuration settings for a connectivity service, including timeout durations, hostname whitelists/blacklists, and specific protocol configurations.

classes.name: ConnectionConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for network connections within the Connectivity service, including protocol-specific configs and timeout settings.

methods.name: getClientActorAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration the connection actor waits for response from client actors, with a default of 60 seconds.

methods.name: getAllowedHostnames
methods.description: Returns a collection of hostnames to which outgoing connections are permitted; overrides blocked hostnames.

methods.name: getBlockedHostnames
methods.description: Returns a collection of hostnames to which outgoing connections are prevented; includes private, wildcard, loopback, and multicast addresses prevention.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration for connection snapshotting behaviour.

methods.name: getAmqp10Config
methods.description: Provides the configuration specific to the AMQP 1.0 protocol.

methods.name: getAmqp091Config
methods.description: Provides the configuration specific to the AMQP 0.9.1 protocol; available since version 1.2.0.

methods.name: getMqttConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration settings specific to the MQTT protocol.

methods.name: getHttpPushConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration for the HTTP push connection type.

methods.name: getAckLabelDeclareInterval
methods.description: Returns how often acknowledgement labels are declared if not yet successful.

enum.name: ConnectionConfigValue
enum.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for ConnectionConfig.

members.name: CLIENT_ACTOR_ASK_TIMEOUT
members.description: Timeout duration for connection actor responses, default 60 seconds.

members.name: ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES
members.description: Comma-separated list of allowed hostnames for outgoing requests.

members.name: BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES
members.description: Comma-separated list of blocked hostnames; prevents outgoing requests to these hosts.

members.name: ACK_LABEL_DECLARE_INTERVAL
members.description: Interval for attempting acknowledgement label declarations, default 10 seconds.
